aboutGame.title: What is Shorekeeper?
paragraphs: Shorekeeper is a limited 5-star Spectro Resonator in Wuthering Waves who wields a Rectifier and fills the healer-support slot. Rather than chasing personal damage, she keeps the team alive with continuous healing and amplifies every damage dealer with team-wide Crit Rate and Crit DMG buffs.

Her signature Stellarealm field follows the active character, so she never forces a fixed position, and her buffs scale with Energy Regen instead of ATK. That design makes her one of the most flexible sustain units in the game and the reason she appears in so many endgame team compositions.

faq.title: Shorekeeper FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Shorekeeper questions, from her role and build to teams and release.

items.question: What is Shorekeeper in Wuthering Waves?
items.answer: Shorekeeper is a limited 5-star Spectro Resonator who wields a Rectifier and fills the healer-support slot. She sustains the team with continuous healing and raises its damage ceiling with team-wide Crit Rate and Crit DMG buffs.

items.question: What stats does Shorekeeper need most?
items.answer: Energy Regen is the priority because her Crit buffs scale with it. After that, build HP% and Healing Bonus for stronger healing, and treat Crit stats as close to worthless on her.

items.question: What is Shorekeeper's best weapon?
items.answer: Stellar Symphony, her signature 5-star Rectifier, is best in slot. Jinzhou Keeper and Variation are strong free and budget options that still provide the Energy Regen she needs.

items.question: Which teams work best with Shorekeeper?
items.answer: Shorekeeper fits almost any damage core because her buffs are element-agnostic. Jinhsi, Camellya, Carlotta, and Jiyan teams all benefit from pairing her with a second buffer or a dedicated carry.

items.question: Which Echo set should Shorekeeper use?
items.answer: Rejuvenating Glow is the safe default for its healing-triggered team ATK buff, while Moonlit Clouds is stronger in fast quick-swap rotations that fire her Outro Skill often.

items.question: When did Shorekeeper release?
items.answer: Shorekeeper debuted in the first phase of Wuthering Waves Version 1.3 in late September 2024 as a limited 5-star banner.

items.question: Is Shorekeeper worth building?
items.answer: Yes. She replaces both a healer and a buffer in one slot, which frees a team slot for extra damage and makes her one of the most valuable supports in the game.
